# DictStore { #timetoalign.DictStore }

```python
DictStore(data=None)
```

Generic EventStore with arbitrary named EventData tables.

Used by AlignmentLoaders that produce a variable number of timelines
(e.g., MatchfileLoader: 1 score + N performances; TiliaJsonLoader:
one table per annotated timeline).

Maintains the uniform EventStore interface (iteration, keys, items,
getitem) while supporting any number of named data sources.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type                                                  | Description                                   | Default   |
|--------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------|-----------|
| data   | [dict](`dict`)\[[str](`str`), \'EventData\'\] \| None | Dictionary mapping names to EventData tables. | `None`    |

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> store = DictStore({
...     "score": score_event_data,
...     "perf:p01": perf_01_event_data,
...     "perf:p02": perf_02_event_data,
... })
>>> for name, events in store.items():
...     print(f"{name}: {len(events)} events")
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [add](#timetoalign.DictStore.add) | Add or replace a named EventData table. |
| [items](#timetoalign.DictStore.items) | Iterate over (name, EventData) pairs in insertion order. |
| [keys](#timetoalign.DictStore.keys) | Return data names in insertion order. |

### add { #timetoalign.DictStore.add }

```python
DictStore.add(name, events)
```

Add or replace a named EventData table.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name   | Type          | Description                                                 | Default    |
|--------|---------------|-------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| name   | [str](`str`)  | The name for this data (e.g., ``"score"``, ``"perf:p01"``). | _required_ |
| events | \'EventData\' | The EventData to store.                                     | _required_ |

### items { #timetoalign.DictStore.items }

```python
DictStore.items()
```

Iterate over (name, EventData) pairs in insertion order.

### keys { #timetoalign.DictStore.keys }

```python
DictStore.keys()
```

Return data names in insertion order.
